title: Massively disappointing communication on payments
body: I wouldn’t recommend this app. I logged in on a browser and chose the 24 day trial for 12.99 to see if I liked the app and if it helped with my adhd related planning and organisation issues. When I then downloaded the app and tried to sign in, I found I couldn’t access Habio from the app. I figured I had only lost 12.99 and forgot about it. Then received an email thanking me for my $100 payment as I hadn’t cancelled during the trial period. I couldn’t find it under my subscriptions to cancel anywhere. When I contacted them about it and asked them to refund my payment, they refused as the situation didn’t meet the criteria in their refund policy. I explained the situation, and that I wasn’t able to access the premium features in the app, and that I wasn’t interested in continuing, but they only responded that I wasn’t eligible under their refund policy. I would suggest their business model is more based off being sneaky and relying on fine print and poorly communicated payments than on actually helping people with organisation and planning. A truly massive disappointment.

title: SCAM! CANT UNSUBSCRIBE!
body: I downloaded this app and accepted the trial period as i have done in the past with many trial periods for apps. I went straight to my subscriptions to cancel it like i usually do so i can use the app for the remaining of the trial period and not be subsequently charged when i haven't decided to fully purchase it or not. This app is a scam and you cannot locate it in your itunes subscriptions or under any usual location of subscriptions on your phone. I had no way of contacting anyone until the email came through thanking me for my payment, which i have now been charged for a month of using this app. I have since explained my situation and requested a refund which has been denied due to me accepting the trail period and using the app during the trial. This charge has left me with little money till my next pay period which the app people don't seem to care about. I hope this review stops others from downloading and accepting the trial as it is impossible to unsubscribe to. Be aware! SCAM SCAM SCAM!
